title: Managing Leads From A Member's Perspective
text:
## Managing Leads From A Member's Perspective
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000103091
Members can manage leads directly from their dashboard. Depending on the lead settings configured by the site administrator, members may be able to:
Purchase a lead
Accept a free lead
Decline a lead
This article explains how each action works and how members can track the status of their assigned leads.

## Purchasing Leads
Please find all the relevant information here: Purchasing Leads

## Accepting Free Leads
An email notification is sent when a lead is assigned. The email contains a link to view the lead details.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12155728959/original/yEyF508A0Gwn6zNJtxaLE4g9F1XGH_zZ7w.png?1737477373 | alt: ]
The link included in the email automatically logs into the dashboard and opens the assigned lead. Clicking on " View Details " will open the lead:
If lead notifications are configured to display a preview only, Accept Lead must be selected before the full contact information becomes available.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12155729072/original/DVMvcB_6_gQsCkseDjpyAzsFRY-Pcyk6fQ.png?1737477471 | alt: ]
After the lead is accepted, the complete lead information becomes available, including contact details such as email address and phone number.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12155729147/original/NFSL0PaSPkY8FWzqCprKAUfbPOs92F_tvA.png?1737477532 | alt: ]

## Declining Leads
The member will receive an email notifying them that they have a lead. A link to view the lead is included in the email template:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12155728959/original/yEyF508A0Gwn6zNJtxaLE4g9F1XGH_zZ7w.png?1737477373 | alt: ]
Clicking on the link will AUTOMATICALLY log that member into his dashboard and take them straight to the lead itself facilitating the purchasing process. Clicking on " View Details " will open the lead:
The member will click on " Decline Lead " to not accept it:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12155729537/original/F-hb3aXqwvohPzVLcYTKCAQP_dWCoAguOw.png?1737477870 | alt: ]
The system will display a pop-up asking for feedback on why the lead was not accepted. This question is optional.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12155729885/original/EFd8pM7k-Wh0fy3oVvCA1UKAcNUoC3fxPg.png?1737478137 | alt: ]
The lead will appear as "Declined" in this section:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12155730211/original/watlVnkjsg1ltegneDa9DYA-Nff25c1T4A.png?1737478330 | alt: ]

## View Declined Lead Reason
The owner of the site views the declined lead reason in the Leads details of the admin:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12155730036/original/Eu_xPlo3FiKS6OVXhgL6eyD7aY6KZ6LGHQ.png?1737478227 | alt: ]

## Member Assigned Lead Status
When a lead is accepted, the following lead statuses will be displayed:
Deal Won
Deal Lost
In Progress
Needs Contact
These statuses are designed to help members efficiently manage their leads on the dashboard.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12155730618/original/J2IFVQ4XK1W-5DRBycObYKJYJMI6OBsUsA.png?1737478676 | alt: ]
This appears in its own column when viewing all leads:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12164354873/original/3xJSSvErkcAALjOEBzfcgC0YdoOvyUNYkA.png?1752609451 | alt: ]

## Lead Status Text Labels
These are text labels which can be found and edited within the Settings » Text Labels :
lead_user_status_won
lead_user_status_deal_lost
lead_user_status_in_progress
lead_user_status_needs_contact
